how: MITM reverse proxy on ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, real credentials, sandboxed HOME + CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; interactive session driven under tmux. See test/cc-wire-fidelity.mjs.
scrubbed: device_id, account_uuid, session ids, absolute paths, email. A 900-line synthetic filler file used as bulk is collapsed to <<<FILLER x900>>>.

captures.name: quota-probe
captures.what: CC quota probe: 1-token non-streaming POST /v1/messages with no system block, fired to read the anthropic-ratelimit-* response headers.

captures.name: session-title
captures.what: Session title generator: structured-outputs request with output_config and temperature.

captures.name: main-loop
captures.what: Interactive main loop, first turn: 55 tools, 3 system blocks, streaming.

captures.name: count-tokens
captures.what: POST /v1/messages/count_tokens — model, messages, tools only; no system, no metadata.

captures.name: compaction
captures.what: A real /compact. Ordinary main-loop system prompt; the summariser instruction is the LAST USER MESSAGE, not a separate system block.

captures.name: api-hello-get
captures.what: api.anthropic.com's answer to GET /api/hello. The request here was issued by curl, not by CC — the fixture exists for the RESPONSE, which is what dario has to match.

captures.name: api-hello-head
captures.what: CC's voice-connectivity probe: HEAD /api/hello, a bare fetch under the embedded runtime's default user-agent with no CC identity headers.

captures.name: headless-sdk
captures.what: Headless claude -p: entrypoint sdk-cli, Claude Agent SDK identity at system[1].

captures.name: headless-main-loop
captures.what: Headless claude -p main loop: cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli, Claude Agent SDK identity, context_management. Its beta list differs from the interactive main loop on an identically-shaped body.

captures.name: image-tool-result
captures.what: Interactive CC after Read on a .png. The image arrives as an `image` block NESTED inside a tool_result content array, and CC puts a cache breakpoint on the tool_result carrying it.

captures.name: subagent-dispatch
captures.what: The Explore subagent CC spawns for a Task. Billing block carries a third field, cc_is_subagent=true; system[1] is the Agent-SDK wording, not the plain CLI one; the tool list is a 32-tool subset.

captures.name: web-search-server-tool
captures.what: CCs dedicated web-search turn. One SERVER tool (a `type` field, no input_schema), tool_choice, temperature, thinking disabled, no context_management, and a beta list with neither claude-code-20250219 nor extended-cache-ttl.

captures.name: thinking-turn
captures.what: A main-loop turn whose assistant history carries thinking blocks, with thinking enabled at budget 31999 and context_management clearing them.

probes.name: errors
probes.what: api.anthropic.com's error envelopes, probed directly rather than provoked through CC — the statuses and the status-to-error.type table, cross-checked against docs.claude.com/en/api/errors.

matrixHow: Second pass, same CC 2.1.236 and same method, aimed at request kinds the first pass never produced: an image, a subagent dispatch, a server-tool web search, and a turn carrying thinking blocks.
